inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The user's single natural-language release-notes request.

inputs.name: targetRepositories
inputs.description: Selected repository identities, absolute paths, and granted access modes.

inputs.name: targetScopeMarkdown
inputs.description: Frontend-computed selected repository roots and access scope.

inputs.name: targetRepositoriesSelectAll
inputs.description: Optional. True when the repository scope is the resolved select-all state; absent or false means an explicit list.

inputs.name: targetRepositoriesScopeAccess
inputs.description: Optional. Access of the resolved select-all scope: write or read. Present only when targetRepositoriesSelectAll is true.
